fullMvp.title: Accepted member to reviewed evidence
fullMvp.requirement: an accepted pilot member receives the exact test/manual-paid entitlement, onboards, opens the common foundation, selects an appropriate assignment, submits a valid artifact, receives authorized human review, revises, and exports a portfolio statement labelled as simulated work. Verify each 30-minute review includes preparation and consumes one of the pilot's four units; publishing content alone does not mark member competence.

fullMvp.title: Privacy attack and revocation
fullMvp.requirement: member B cannot read member A's evidence through guessed routes, object identifiers, or staff APIs. A reviewer sees only assigned material. Revocation prevents obtaining a new download link; prior short-lived links follow the documented expiry. Editor access cannot reveal member submissions.

fullMvp.title: Last slot and last unit
fullMvp.requirement: two members attempt the same slot; exactly one booking wins. One member opens two bookings with only one unit; exactly one reserves it. Cancellation/no-show/platform failure applies the disclosed policy and restores a replacement credit exactly once. The monthly coach unit reserves 45 call minutes plus 15 preparation minutes.

fullMvp.title: Pilot, continuation, renewal, and payment interruption
fullMvp.requirement: run standalone CAD 3,000 pilot, explicit CAD 9,000 ten-month conversion, and twelve-month renewal/direct Professional. Ensure original anniversary, exact allowance totals, invoices, and payment schedule are correct. Duplicate/delayed/out-of-order test events, failed instalment/recovery, cancellation, and manual refund decisions remain consistent. Unconverted pilot is never charged again.

fullMvp.title: AI consent, grounding, quota, and cost
fullMvp.requirement: opt-out prevents dispatch. Deterministic demo is visibly simulated. Live provider absence disables live execution without breaking demo. A timeout is recoverable without duplicate paid work. Monthly 20-mock/100-study allowances and the 30-turn cap are enforced. Sparse interviews return insufficient evidence; study output uses permitted sources; a budget stop triggers a truthful service-recovery path.

fullMvp.title: Content and template update
fullMvp.requirement: member starts version 1; editor publishes version 2; original review retains its rubric/content references. New enrollment uses eligible current material. A template shows tested compatibility, known failures, and stale/retired status. Nothing in an uploaded document can grant AI permission to send messages or access systems.

fullMvp.title: Post-program ongoing service
fullMvp.requirement: after explicit continuation, member receives only the next month's Professional allowance, attends an available clinic, uses one goal/renewal workflow, books covered support, and sees appropriate activity. Clinic participation does not create private hours; training completion never auto-increments rate increases or verified contracts.

fullMvp.title: All-role admission and truthful expertise
fullMvp.requirement: a cybersecurity or product contractor can onboard into the foundation when their branch is limited. They see actual scope, readiness, and reviewer coverage. Tailored service waits for coverage; an appropriate available service proceeds. A project manager is not assessed using a generic coding rubric.

fullMvp.title: Operator reconciliation and privacy lifecycle
fullMvp.requirement: operator resolves a booking exception, reviews an early-release/refund request, reconciles invoice/ledger/provider/manual records, exports an authorized member's data, and completes a deletion workflow with retained-record exceptions documented. Cost report counts preparation once, distinguishes estimated AI cost, and excludes demo events from live business metrics.

fullMvp.title: All-role access and honest coverage
fullMvp.requirement: a cybersecurity member and a business-analysis member can both apply and use the shared foundation. A branch without qualified coverage cannot sell tailored review. A demo expert does not satisfy live readiness.

fullMvp.title: Private assessment
fullMvp.requirement: member A uploads and revises evidence; assigned reviewer publishes feedback; member B and an unassigned coach cannot read it. Revoking the reviewer stops subsequent downloads, including through an old link after its short expiry.

fullMvp.title: Booking and quota concurrency
fullMvp.requirement: two simultaneous attempts for the last slot/credit yield one success and one clear, recoverable failure. Staff cancellation restores the correct dated credit without erasing history.

fullMvp.title: Pilot conversion
fullMvp.requirement: a CAD 3,000 pilot followed by a timely accepted CAD 9,000 continuation yields twelve total service months anchored at the pilot start, correct remaining monthly grants, and no duplicate charge or grant. A non-converter is not charged. Late acceptance cannot activate the standard continuation or bill missed service; it requires an explicitly accepted replacement agreement. Direct annual enrollment and a later renewal use their own correct phases.

fullMvp.title: Payment disorder
fullMvp.requirement: duplicate and out-of-order payment events are idempotent; stale events cannot overwrite a newer paid state; refunds and early-release decisions produce an auditable result. Reconciliation exposes exceptions.

fullMvp.title: AI reliability and budget
fullMvp.requirement: role-specific interview feedback links to member responses; insufficient evidence is explicit; malicious uploaded instructions cannot access other workspaces or tools; provider timeout/malformed output restores or settles the correct usage reservation and is shown honestly.

fullMvp.title: Content and template versions
fullMvp.requirement: a revised rubric does not change a completed assessment. A retired or unverified template is not presented as currently supported. Downloads and sample tests work for the declared version.

fullMvp.title: Privacy and deletion
fullMvp.requirement: exports include only the requesting member's permitted records; revoked sharing stops access; a deletion request removes the configured active and derived material while accurately reporting any separately retained billing/backup records.

fullMvp.title: Commercial truth
fullMvp.requirement: demo payments and seed outcomes are excluded from production metrics. Higher tiers cannot be purchased without publication, capacity, and scope. Pricing, quotas, and terms shown at acceptance match the offer version stored with the agreement.

fullMvp.title: Usability and recovery
fullMvp.requirement: the core journey works at narrow/mobile widths, with keyboard navigation, labels, readable validation, empty/error/loading states, and page-reload recovery. No non-functional button is presented as a completed feature.

fullMvp.title: General learner with no job title, client, contract or coding experience
fullMvp.requirement: Register with an exploratory goal, enter the foundation, complete a noncoding exercise and see private progress; no professional-coaching purchase or IT-fit approval is required

fullMvp.title: IT practitioner and non-IT professional with different goals
fullMvp.requirement: Each selects a suitable path, opens accessible material and completes a relevant assignment; IT coding tasks are not imposed on noncoding paths

fullMvp.title: Member changes interests or returns after a gap
fullMvp.requirement: Update goals and resume; preserved evidence remains versioned, next actions reflect eligible content, and empty/error/recovery states stay useful

fullMvp.title: Member with private work joins a learning circle
fullMvp.requirement: Opt into a suitable group, participate within its rules, report a problem and leave; private evidence is not disclosed, revoked access is enforced, and moderation is accountable

fullMvp.title: Member proposes a reusable workflow or learning resource
fullMvp.requirement: Provide attribution/rights, submit for review, publish only after explicit consent and approval, then revoke sharing; unreviewed contributions cannot masquerade as qualified instruction

fullMvp.title: Learner wants study help rather than an interview or contract
fullMvp.requirement: Use source-grounded study/practice, choose a goal-appropriate format and see labelled feedback; career practice remains optional and unconfigured providers remain disabled

fullMvp.title: Member considers an optional coaching offer
fullMvp.requirement: See actual scope/capacity, accept the versioned offer explicitly, receive correct allowances and cancellation/export rights; no automatic upgrade or confusion between background and paid tier

fullMvp.title: Operator reviews learner/community outcomes and paid-service outcomes
fullMvp.requirement: View separate, defined measures for learning, participation, reviewed contributions and paid conversion; demo data/self-reported outcomes remain labelled and sensitive member data is not exposed

note: Original nine roadmap journeys, ten build-prompt journeys (including late continuation/recovery), and eight ecosystem journeys remain separately visible. Overlap is intentional until reviewed decomposition maps every AC; no whole full-MVP journey is claimed complete by this local slice.
